newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia wool indicator rises 10 cents to 650c/kg.
newsitem.headline: Australia wool indicator rises 10 cents to 650c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator rose ten cents to 650 cents a kg clean on Tuesday at sales in Sydney and Melbourne, Wool International said.
Merino fleece was mostly dearer, with 19/20/21 microns 1.5 percent dearer, 22/23m up to 2.5 percent dearer, 24m 0.5 percent dearer, 25/26m slightly cheaper, and merino skirtings one percent dearer.
In crossbreds, 27/29/31m were slightly dearer, 28m 0.5 percent dearer and 30m up to 1.5 percent dearer, it said.
